verdict.rationale: Docs and MCP server evidence confirm dedicated news search, image search, video search, and local/POI search endpoints, plus 'rich' vertical data (sports, stocks, weather) embedded in web search responses—covering much of the freshness/vertical-coverage need. However, there's no explicit 'finance' endpoint beyond generic stock snippets, and no dedicated finance vertical API is documented, so coverage is partial relative to the story's specific mention of finance.
